units.text: INT. SUPERMAN - CONTINUOUS
He blocks the way.
The stampede it checked.
What has happened?
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: THE SULKY SOCIAL-DEMOCRAT, A motor--
Three men--
units.name: THE ANARCHIST

units.text: Deux femmes--
units.name: DUVAL

units.text: Three men and two women! Why have you not brought them here? Are you afraid of them?
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: getting up.
Thyve a hescort. Ow, de-ooh lut's ook it, Mendowza.
units.name: THE ROWDY ONE

units.text: Two armored cars full o soldiers at the end o the valley.
units.name: THE SULKY ONE

units.text: The shot was fired in the air. It was a signal.
units.name: ANARCHIST

units.text: Straker whistles his favorite air, which falls on the ears of the brigands like a funeral march.
It is not an escort, but an expedition to capture you. We were advised to wait for it; but I was in a hurry.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: in an agony of apprehension.
And Ow my good Lord, ere we are, wytin for em! Lut's tike to the mahntns.
units.name: THE ROWDY ONE

units.text: Idiot, what do you know about the mountains? Are you a Spaniard? You would be given up by the first shepherd you met. Besides, we are already within range of their rifles.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: Bat--
units.name: THE ROWDY ONE

units.text: Silence. Leave this to me.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: To Tanner.
Comrade: you will not betray us.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: Oo are you callin comrade?
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: Last night the advantage was with me. The robber of the poor was at the mercy of the robber of the rich. You offered your hand: I took it.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: I bring no charge against you, comrade. We have spent a pleasant evening with you: that is all.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: I gev my and to nobody, see?
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: turning on him impressively.

Young man, if I am tried, I shall plead guilty, and explain what drove me from England, home and duty. Do you wish to have the respectable name of Straker dragged through the mud of a Spanish criminal court? The police will search me. They will find Louisa's portrait. It will be published in the illustrated papers. You blench. It will be your doing, remember.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: with baffled rage.
I don't care about the court. It's avin our name mixed up with yours that I object to, you blackmailin swine, you.
units.name: STRAKER

units.text: Language unworthy of Louisa's brother! But no matter: you are muzzled: that is enough for us.
units.name: MENDOZA

units.text: He turns to face his own men, who back uneasily across the amphitheatre towards the cave to take refuge behind him, as a fresh party, muffled for motoring, comes from the road in riotous spirits.
Ann, who makes straight for Tanner, comes first; then Violet, helped over the rough ground by Hector holding her right hand and Ramsden her left.

Mendoza goes to his presidential block and seats himself calmly with his rank and file grouped behind him, and his Staff, consisting of Duval and the Anarchist on his right and the two Social-Democrats on his left, supporting him in flank.
It's Jack!
units.name: ANN

units.text: Caught!
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Why, certainly it is. I said it was you, Tanner, We've just been stopped by a puncture: the road is full of nails.
units.name: HECTOR

units.text: What are you doing here with all these men?
units.name: VIOLET

units.text: Why did you leave us without a word of warning?
units.name: ANN

units.text: I want that bunch of roses, Miss Whitefield.
units.name: HECTOR

units.text: To Tanner.
When we found you were gone, Miss Whitefield bet me a bunch of roses my car would not overtake yours before you reached Monte Carlo.
units.name: HECTOR

units.text: But this is not the road to Monte Carlo.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: No matter. Miss Whitefield tracked you at every stopping place: she is a regular Sherlock Holmes.
units.name: HECTOR

units.text: The Life Force! I am lost.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Bounding gaily down from the road into the amphitheatre, and coming between Tanner and Straker.
I am so glad you are safe, old chap. We were afraid you had been captured by brigands.
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: who has been staring at Mendoza.
I seem to remember the face of your friend here.
units.name: RAMSDEN

units.text: Mendoza rises politely and advances with a smile between Ann and Ramsden.
